sloka: बिभ्यतो राम बाणानाम् अन्तरा पतिता भवेत् ।अथवा ह्रियमाणायाः पथि सिद्ध निषेविते ॥५-१३-८॥
transliteration: bibhyato rāma bāṇānām antarā patitā bhavet ।athavā hriyamāṇāyāḥ pathi siddha niṣevite ॥5-13-8॥

translations.english: "Or, perhaps while being borne away on the path frequented by siddhas, the beloved of Rama might have fallen down (dead), heart broken, on seeing the (vast) sea.
